column1: # Title: PLEXOS-World Hourly Electricity Load Data

# Comments: Hourly electricity demand profiles for all modeled countries and sub-country regions in PLEXOS-World. Approximately 50% of profiles are based on historical data retrieved through system operators and other entities.  For more details see the paper documenting methodology at https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2211467X20301450?via%3Dihub.
